name: StudioLM
description: Image-generation site whose API also serves chat with a free daily token allowance.
overview: StudioLM is a browser image generator with a developer API at api.studiolm.dev. Images cost a cent each from prepaid credit, but the API's chat completions route carries a free daily token allowance on the small open model it serves, gemma-3-12b-it-qat, so text generation works without adding funds. Routes follow the OpenAI layout and there is a Python SDK called studiolm.
free_access: Free daily token allowance on the chat route
OpenAI-shaped /v1 routes and a Python SDK
Image generation is paid ($0.01 per image)
notes: The free allowance covers chat only; images always draw on prepaid credit.

models.name: Gemma 3 12B IT QAT
models.rate_limits: Free daily token allowance, amount not published
